text.p: These are the leading stories in the Sarajevo press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- The Bosnian government's goal is to rehabilitate and reintegrate the country as soon as possible, Prime Minister Hasan Muratovic said in Sarajevo on Monday at a ceremony marking the national day.

- The chairman of the three-member Bosnian Presidency, Alija Izetbegovic, met on Monday with representatives of the Swedish company Plena Group, which provided 550,000 German marks for the reconstruction of the Bosnian Railway's freight cars.
- I welcome the words of President Izetbegovic and their echo about tolerance for all, international High Representative to Bosnia, Carl Bildt, said in his message for the Bosnian national day.

- "We won't let you divide Bosnia," is motto of a demonstration due to be held in central Sarajevo on Tuesday in which Sarajevans will protest against poor implementation of the Dayton peace agreement. --Sarajevo newsroom, +387-71-663-864.
